title: 機翼翼梢小翼工程
summary: 以翼梢小翼的原創比較構型研究誘導阻力、結構彎矩、扭轉和重量取捨；必須在相同升力條件下比較，不能只看單一阻力數。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use original winglet comparison configurations to study induced drag, bending, twist and mass tradeoffs at matched lift rather than relying on a single drag number. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 翼尖裝置的幾何定義：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Geometry definition of a wingtip device: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 翼尖裝置的幾何定義 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Geometry definition of a wingtip device and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 展弦比以翼展平方除參考面積，表達有限翼三維效應；縮尺模型保留幾何比例不會自動保留流動相似性。
steps.instructionEn: Aspect ratio is span squared divided by reference area and describes finite-wing geometry; geometric scaling alone does not preserve flow similarity.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非機翼翼梢小翼工程實際性能或製程：翼展b=12 m，面積S=18 m²。式 AR=b²/S，基準結果 8 dimensionless。適用條件：投影翼面積且翼展定義一致；不是翼梢形狀的完整模型。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Winglet engineering: Span b=12 m and reference area S=18 m². Formula AR=b²/S gives 8 dimensionless. Conditions: Consistent projected area and span definitions; not a full model of wingtip geometry.
steps.failure: 混用單翼面積與全翼翼展會把展弦比放大兩倍。
steps.failureEn: Combining half-wing area with full span doubles the calculated aspect ratio.
steps.check: 在同一投影圖量翼展與面積，把翼梢裝置的投影規則列在表格。
steps.checkEn: Measure span and area on one projection and document how wingtip devices are included.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「機翼翼梢小翼工程」的「翼尖裝置的幾何定義：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「風洞值班：把曲線說清楚」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Geometry definition of a wingtip device: Mechanism and observation” in “Winglet engineering”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Wind-Tunnel Shift: Explain the Curves” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 比較構型的相同升力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Matched lift across configurations: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 比較構型的相同升力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Matched lift across configurations and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 升力由動壓、參考翼面積與升力係數相乘；係數含翼型、迎角、雷諾數及壓縮性條件。
steps.instructionEn: Lift multiplies dynamic pressure, reference wing area and lift coefficient; the coefficient depends on section, incidence, Reynolds number and compressibility.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非機翼翼梢小翼工程實際性能或製程：ρ=1.2 kg/m³，V=30 m/s，S=2 m²，CL=0.6。式 L=ρV²SCL/2，基準結果 648 N。適用條件：低速固定CL模型，未描述失速或三維分離。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Winglet engineering: rho=1.2 kg/m³, V=30 m/s, S=2 m² and CL=0.6. Formula L=ρV²SCL/2 gives 648 N. Conditions: Low-speed fixed-CL model, excluding stall and three-dimensional separation.
steps.failure: 使用濕面積取代參考翼面積會使係數不可比；分離後不能保持線性CL。
steps.failureEn: Using wetted area instead of reference wing area breaks coefficient comparisons; CL cannot remain linear after separation.
steps.check: 扣除支架皮重，以同一面積正規化力天平讀值，分別記錄迎角上掃與下掃。
steps.checkEn: Subtract support tare, normalize balance forces with one area definition, and record increasing and decreasing incidence separately.

steps.instruction: 原創教學假設，非機翼翼梢小翼工程實際性能或製程：ρ=1.2 kg/m³，V=30 m/s，S=2 m²，CL=0.6。式 L=ρV²SCL/2，基準結果 648 N。適用條件：低速固定CL模型，未描述失速或三維分離。
